speaker: Doctor
text: Does the stridor and wheezing improve or disappear when the infant's neck is extended? Has he had any previous episodes of severe respiratory distress or required emergency intervention?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. I also have Exacerbation during crying, Exacerbation during feeding, Exacerbation with neck flexion, Relief with neck extension, Occasional vomiting post-feeding.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Flexible_laryngoscopy. I also need to know if the stridor is constant or intermittent, and if it is inspiratory, expiratory, or biphasic.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the flexible laryngoscopy was normal, this points to an extrinsic compression rather than a primary laryngeal issue. REQUEST TEST: Chest_and_Neck_CT. Is the stridor biphasic, and does it worsen significantly when the infant is supine?
